Escalation Timeline · 20 Days

From Strikes to Infrastructure War

Phase 1 closed the strait. Phase 2 is destroying what lies behind it.

Phase 1 — Strait Closure
Phase 2 — Infrastructure War
FEB 28 — DAY 1
900 strikes in 12 hours. Khamenei killed. Iran retaliates — 500+ missiles, 2,000 drones.
MAR 1 — DAY 2
Traffic drops 70%. Maersk, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd suspend all transits.
MAR 4 — DAY 5
Strait officially closed. Only Chinese vessels permitted passage.
MAR 10 — DAY 11
Iran lays naval mines. US sinks 16 minelayers. 21 attacks on merchant ships.
MAR 14 — DAY 15
First day of zero crossings. 850 tankers stranded globally.
MAR 17 — DAY 18
Shah gas field + Fujairah hit. Larijani killed. Israel invades Lebanon.
MAR 18 — DAY 19
South Pars struck. Iran hits Ras Laffan, Ras Tanura. Energy infrastructure war begins.
MAR 19 — DAY 20
US bunker busters on Hormuz. Trump threatens to 'massively blow up' South Pars.
Phase 1 closed the strait. Phase 2 is destroying the infrastructure behind it. Even when the strait reopens, the loading terminals need months of repair.

Sources: Wikipedia, Al Jazeera, CNN, CNBC
